known_remaining: Natural/reference-quality shape, material, regional/scenic-target work remains; artistic sign-off is false.
Finite spiral-shaft/gallery fixtures are not natural infinite connected cave networks or deep brain chambers.
Twelve static walks cover three seeds; the one actual streaming walk pauses to preload and is not uninterrupted performance certification.
Quarry grades cover eight admitted inland centreline routes on canonical and 2/4 m grids; not exhaustive capsule, mixed-owner, custom-scale or all-quarry traversal certification.
Generated mycelium is an original 1254-square albedo resampled to 2048, not a photographed PBR scan; mirrored/rotated shader borders do not prove source pixels are perfectly tileable.
Accelerated fixed-step headless physics sometimes emitted a Jolt job-capacity warning; no actual runtime-performance conclusion is drawn from its elapsed time.
Cold startup and streaming frame spikes remain measured performance work.

Infinite Default Cave remains queued after surface completion, followed by the same-network registry plus Default/Frozen, then Crystal Caverns, then Magma Caverns. Later biome implementation is authorized only in that strict sequential order; no specialized cave biome is complete.

latest_queued_request.acceptance: Actual procedural generation of the 56 named test cases, fixed-seed distributions and separate accessible-area coverage, rare 2%/1000–2000m regions, no mandatory molten crossing/jump/drop, full Volcanic surface-to-Default-to-cooled/active-Magma-to-surface physical return walk. Validate actual basins and dry bypasses, geometry/material transitions, collision, deterministic ownership/seams/LOD, bounded memory, CPU/GPU cost and native visual quality. Preserve the complete brief's final report requirements.
latest_queued_request.brief_review_status: Complete 3123-line brief read. Preserve all twenty implementation stages and distribution, visual, physical traversal, streaming and performance acceptance gates; recording this request is not implementation.
latest_queued_request.excluded: No creatures, lava damage/burning, eruptions, particles/smoke/steam, new audio/weather, mining, destructible terrain, inventory, buildings or unrelated gameplay. Do not implement separate Sulfur/Alien Hive/future cave biomes in this phase.
latest_queued_request.integration_note: Keep candidate rarity, extent, smooth relative depth preference, actual surface affinity and environmental suitability independent. Zero normal L1 spawning. Desert is not a current live owner and Rocky Coast is an overlay: map real semantics instead of inventing IDs. Volcanic origin is distinct from present heat; exposed molten rock needs a suitable heat source, not depth alone. Reuse compatible Volcanic materials/rendering without rebuilding the cave engine or recoloring ocean water.
latest_queued_request.scope: Extend the same connected cave geometry and registry with coherent volcanic age, intrusive geology and separately controlled geothermal activity. Real ancient lava tubes, enormous basalt chambers/cathedrals, smooth ropy and rough hardened flows, fissures, selective columnar basalt, obsidian, ash/scoria and weathering. Mostly dormant geology with rare basin-conforming molten lakes/channels, dark cooling crust and controlled dedicated lava shading. Preserve Default/Frozen/Crystal and every required dry two-way route.

profiling_caveat: Three ordered Alien runs, not a randomized repeat distribution. Measured before the latest fungal/transition/rim revisions. Payload retains worker numeric collision arrays and removes mesh readback/duplicate cavity uploads; a 51.874 ms staging outlier still occurred. Not a claim that stalls are solved.
